decisions.why: Biobrace products are clearly orthopedic joint implants and articular anchors for orthopedic repair.
Plating systems (5MS, Colink PCR, Colink2, Colink AFX) are fracture fixation and trauma devices for orthopedic trauma management.
Exactrace, Totaltrace, and Cleartrace product lines are ECG electrode gels and tracing supplies for cardiac monitoring.
Nakao Spider Net Retrieval Device exemplifies access and retrieval devices used in gastrointestinal endoscopy procedures.
Alloaid implants and allograft tissue products are orthopedic biological implants for joint and tissue reconstruction.
Hall power drills and large bone power instruments are orthopedic surgical equipment used in fracture and joint procedures.
Sphincterotomes, papillotomes, and guidewires are endoscopic consumables specifically used in biliary and pancreatic endoscopy.
Smoke evacuation pencils, filters, and tubing are general theatre consumables for smoke management during surgical procedures.
Edge Bipolar RF System represents advanced energy-based devices for radiofrequency ablation in minimally invasive arthroscopic surgery.
Quantum Total Ankle System and metatarsal implants are orthopedic arthroplasty implants for foot and ankle joint reconstruction.
